name: Chipotle Lime Chicken Bowls
kidPlate: Serve daughter's portion without chipotle sauce; use mild salsa instead. Skip jalapeños on her bowl.
steps: Blend chipotle peppers, sour cream, lime juice, garlic, and cilantro until smooth. Season with salt.
Pat chicken dry and season with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook chicken 6-7 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 165°F. Rest 3 minutes, then slice.
Warm black beans and corn together in a small pot, about 3 minutes.
Dice bell pepper and jalapeño while chicken rests.
Divide cooked rice among four bowls. Top with black bean-corn mixture, sliced chicken, diced peppers.
Drizzle chipotle sauce generously over each bowl. Sprinkle cotija cheese and fresh cilantro on top.
notes: Prep rice ahead to hit 18-minute target. Chicken cooks fastest when pounded to even thickness. Make daughter's chipotle sauce separately with mild salsa for heat control.

name: Thai Basil Chicken with Jasmine Rice
kidPlate: Serve daughter's portion without Thai chilies and fish sauce; use soy sauce only for salt, add extra jasmine rice
steps: Bring 3 cups water to boil in covered pot. Add jasmine rice, stir once, reduce heat to low, cover, cook 15 minutes until tender.
While rice cooks, slice chicken breast into bite-sized pieces. Mince garlic. Dice red bell pepper. Slice Thai chilies into rings.
Heat oil in large wok or skillet over high heat. Once shimmering, add garlic and chilies, stir 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add chicken pieces to wok, cook 5-6 minutes stirring frequently until golden and cooked through.
Add red bell pepper, fish sauce, soy sauce, and lime juice. Toss constantly for 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in fresh Thai basil just before serving.
Serve chicken and sauce over jasmine rice.
notes: City Market carries Thai basil in produce section. If unavailable, use regular basil (less aromatic but still delicious). Remove whole chilies before serving if daughter eating with adults to control heat level for her plate.

name: Spiced Ground Beef Tacos with Cilantro Lime Crema
kidPlate: Build her tacos with seasoned beef, cheese, and sour cream only — skip the cilantro crema and jalapeños
steps: Zest lime, then cut in half. Juice both halves into a bowl with sour cream, cilantro, jalapeño, lime zest, and pinch of salt — set cilantro crema aside.
Heat olive oil in large skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion, cook 3 minutes until softened.
Add garlic, cook 1 minute until fragrant. Add ground beef, breaking into small pieces with spoon.
Cook beef 6-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until no pink remains. Drain excess fat if needed.
Stir in cumin, chili powder, paprika, and chipotle powder. Cook 1 minute.
Warm tortillas over open flame or in dry skillet, 15 seconds per side.
Build tacos: place warm tortilla, add beef mixture, cheese, lettuce, tomato, and drizzle cilantro crema on top.
Serve remaining crema on the side for dipping.
notes: Ground beef delivers savory depth here; the smoky spice blend and cilantro crema make these genuinely crave-worthy. Daughter's version uses plain sour cream instead of the spiced crema — same beef, simpler toppings. Timing includes tortilla warming. For extra punch, add pickled onions or cotija cheese.

name: Chorizo Scramble with Crispy Potatoes
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add frozen potatoes and cook 6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden and crispy.
Push potatoes to the side, add chorizo to the pan, break into small pieces, and cook 2-3 minutes until browned.
Crack eggs into the pan, scramble together with chorizo and potatoes for 2-3 minutes.
Top with cheddar cheese and sliced jalapeños in the final minute of cooking.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve immediately.
notes: Chorizo adds bold flavor and extra protein. Use pre-diced frozen potatoes to save prep time. Jalapeño is optional but recommended for flavor punch.

name: Mediterranean Tuna Salad Sandwich
steps: Drain tuna thoroughly and place in a bowl
Mix tuna with Greek yogurt, red onion, kalamata olives, dill, and lemon juice
Toast bread slices until golden
Layer spinach on toasted bread
Spread tuna mixture evenly on bread
Top with cucumber slices and close sandwich
Slice diagonally and serve immediately
notes: Bold briny flavors from olives and tuna keep this light lunch feeling substantial. Greek yogurt replaces mayo for extra protein.

name: Spicy Beef Jerky & Cheese Plate
steps: Portion beef jerky and cheddar cheese cubes into a small container or plate
Add almonds on the side
Include pickle chips for crunch and bold flavor
Eat immediately or pack for on-the-go
notes: Zero cooking required. The spicy jerky and tangy pickle provide bold satisfaction without diet-food vibes. Great for afternoon energy or post-workout quick protein boost. Pack in a small container for trail or work.

name: Steak & Egg Breakfast Hash with Cheddar
steps: Heat butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cube sirloin steak and season with salt and pepper. Sear 2-3 minutes until browned; set aside.
Add frozen potatoes to same skillet, cook 4 minutes until starting to brown.
Add diced onion and bell peppers, cook 3 minutes until softened.
Return steak to skillet and stir to combine.
Push mixture to sides, crack 2 eggs into center of pan, let cook 2 minutes until whites set.
Fold eggs into hash, top with shredded cheddar, cover for 1 minute until melted.
Serve immediately.
notes: Meal prepped steak works great here—cook while frozen potatoes thaw. Adjust potato amount if you need more carbs. This delivers umami and satisfaction to kickstart your day.

name: Loaded Breakfast Sandwich with Turkey Sausage & Avocado
steps: Cook turkey sausage patties in a skillet over medium-high heat for 4-5 minutes until browned, flipping once. Set aside.
In the same skillet with remaining sausage fat, add butter and wilt spinach for 1 minute. Remove to a plate.
Crack eggs into skillet and cook over medium heat (fried or scrambled) for 2-3 minutes to your preference. Season with salt and pepper.
Toast English muffin until golden and crispy.
Spread sriracha mayo on the bottom half of muffin.
Layer bottom muffin half: wilted spinach, cooked eggs, cheddar slice, turkey sausage patties.
Slice avocado and layer on top of sausage.
Cap with top muffin half and serve immediately.
notes: The sriracha mayo adds serious flavor without excess calories. Use pre-cooked sausage patties to shave 2 minutes off cook time. Can swap avocado for bacon if preferred.

name: Greek Yogurt Power Parfait with Granola & Berries
steps: Spoon Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Layer granola over yogurt.
Top with fresh berries.
Scatter chopped almonds on top.
Drizzle honey over the parfait.
Eat immediately for crispy granola, or let sit 2 minutes for softer texture.
notes: Full-fat Greek yogurt delivers richness and staying power. Granola adds bold texture and flavor without tasting like diet food. Berries bring natural sweetness and micronutrients. This hits protein targets hard while staying well under calorie budget.

name: Peanut Butter & Apple with Granola Crunch
steps: Slice apple into quarters, removing core
Spread peanut butter directly onto apple slices or use as dip
Pour granola into small bowl
Dip peanut butter-coated apple into granola for crunch
Drizzle honey over peanut butter for extra flavor
notes: Stays fresh in a container for hours. Crunch factor makes this feel indulgent while hitting macro targets. Swap granola type based on preference—almond clusters work great too.

name: Grilled Chicken & Black Bean Power Wrap
steps: Warm the tortilla in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side
Slice the grilled chicken and warm in the same skillet with black beans (1 minute)
Lay tortilla flat and spread salsa verde down the center
Layer chicken, beans, cheese, avocado slices, and red onion
Squeeze lime juice over filling
Roll tightly, cut in half, and serve immediately
notes: Use rotisserie or pre-grilled chicken from the deli counter to stay under 15 minutes. The wrap is hearty enough to fuel afternoon workouts without heaviness.

name: Italian Deli Protein Wrap with Roasted Red Peppers
steps: Warm tortilla in a dry skillet or microwave for 30 seconds until pliable.
Toss spinach with balsamic vinegar, olive oil, garlic powder, and black pepper in a bowl.
Lay tortilla flat and layer turkey breast down the center, then mozzarella, roasted red peppers, and dressed spinach.
Roll tightly, slice diagonally, and serve immediately or wrap in foil for transport.
notes: All ingredients available at City Market. Roasted red peppers in jarred form saves prep time. Can be made 2-3 hours ahead and wrapped in foil.

name: Herb-Crusted Pork Chops with Roasted Root Vegetables & Garlic Aioli
kidPlate: Serve daughter's pork chop plain (no herb crust), with roasted carrots and potatoes only. Skip garlic aioli.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Cube potatoes, carrots, and parsnips. Toss with 2 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper. Spread on baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes.
While vegetables roast, mince 3 garlic cloves and combine with parsley, thyme, panko, salt, and pepper in a shallow dish.
Beat egg in another shallow dish. Pat pork chops dry, dip in egg, then coat both sides with herb-panko mixture.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear pork chops 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to oven for final 8–10 minutes until cooked through (145°F internal temp).
Make garlic aioli: mince 1 raw garlic clove, whisk with mayo and lemon juice until smooth.
Remove vegetables from oven and stir. Add pork chops to sheet and bake together for final 8 minutes. Serve pork, vegetables, and aioli on the side.
notes: For daughter: skip the herb crust entirely and pan-sear her pork chop plain in butter. Roast her potatoes and carrots separately without the parsnips (if she dislikes them). Omit aioli. This keeps her meal simple while adults enjoy the full flavor profile. Pork chops are economical at City Market and cook fast.
